title: ken-1: keystore module — wp11_keystore.h + wp11_keystore.c + settings/Makefile
description:
Create the core keystore module: format dispatch, .p11k v1 load/create, mlock/zeroize lifecycle.

New files:
- wolfp11/wp11_keystore.h — wp11_key_entry_t, wp11_keystore_t, error codes, public API
- src/wp11_keystore.c — .p11k parser/writer, minimal purpose-built CBOR codec, PBKDF2+AES-256-GCM, mlock

Also update:
- wolfp11/wp11_settings.h — add WOLFP11_CFG_USB_FLASH_BACKEND and WOLFP11_CFG_USB_FLASH_WATCH_DIR
- Makefile — USBFLASH=1 opt-in adds -DWOLFP11_CFG_USB_FLASH_BACKEND and src/wp11_keystore.c + src/wp11_backend_usb_flash.c to SRCS

CBOR: write purpose-built minimal codec (encode + decode) for exactly the .p11k payload structure. No external CBOR library — the structure is fixed and a purpose-built parser is ~300 lines, fully bounded.

Security: mlock immediately after decrypt; ForceZero before free; reject PBKDF2 iter < 100000; format dispatch on magic bytes not extension.
